name: Pulumi
summary: Pulumi defines infrastructure in general-purpose programming languages and stores its state in Pulumi Cloud or another backend. Its pricing page lists a free tier for 1 user, Essentials at $40 a month and Pro at $400 a month, with Enterprise by quote.

facts.text: Pulumi compares its recorded state against the configuration declared in the program.
A Pulumi backend is an API and storage endpoint that the CLI uses to coordinate updates. Pulumi Cloud is one backend option.
The pulumi preview command shows a preview of updates to a stack's resources, and no changes to the stack take place.
The free tier includes IaC state management and Pulumi Deployments, with 1 user and up to 500 workflow minutes, according to the pricing page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: No credit card required. Up to 500 workflow minutes, 25 secrets and 10,000 API calls a month.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Up to 500 managed resources and unlimited users.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Up to 2,000 managed resources and unlimited users.

hiddenCosts: The page lists per-unit rates for IaC resources, ESC secrets and workflow minutes on top of the monthly base. Workflow minutes cost $0.01 each on Essentials and Pro.
The pricing page does not mention preview or plan features in its plan table.
